name: Himesaki Aoi
source:
She’s the only daughter of a local shrine, serving as both a miko and a housekeeper. She almost exclusively wears traditional Japanese clothing, a true “Yamato Nadeshiko,” which is rare these days.

In her mid-20s, she’s extremely fastidious and hates so-called “playboys.” Naturally, the protagonist falls into that category, and she despises him like the plague in the early stages of the story.

Although she has a gentle nature, she’s strong-willed and absolutely refuses to compromise.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/212481/]Getchu[/url]]
